jobs.name: counters
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas for Trætoppen's modular shop interiors.
Match the provided approved painted shop source and furniture source; the fox portrait establishes the friendly world, do not draw a character. Matte storybook gouache and watercolor, fine irregular warm grey-brown pencil contours, restrained paper grain, worn honey pine, muted sage, cream, lavender accents, terracotta and charcoal iron. Hand painted objects with soft edges and clear silhouettes. No plastic or polished CG, no photorealism, no pixel art.
Camera is orthographic elevated 36 degrees, native isometric floor axes approximately +30.7 and -30.7 degrees. All vertical posts remain vertical. Each object fully visible, centered in its own cell, with generous TRANSPARENT gutters on all sides; detached accents stay near their own object. Actual transparent background, no drop shadow, no floor, no scenery, no grid lines, no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermarks. Absolutely no objects may touch or cross the atlas cell boundaries.
The same row shows the SAME physical object, identical materials, dimensions and small details. True quarter-turn views, NOT mirrors. Front sides carry functional openings, rear views show believable plain backs, not front openings repeated on the back. Keep fine details sparse enough to read at game zoom.
Create exactly THREE ROWS and FOUR COLUMNS, 12 separate drawings, landscape 2048 x 1536.
Columns left to right: r0 front-right view (front service side and right end visible); r1 front-left view (same front service side and left end visible); r2 rear-left view (staff storage back and left end); r3 rear-right view (staff storage back and right end).
Row 1: long shop counter, ground footprint 3 by 1, broad honey timber worktop, three sage recessed front panels, sturdy short feet, open staff shelving along the back. Long axis runs left-to-right on the r0/r2 isometric diagonal and the other diagonal on r1/r3.
Row 2: single 1 by 1 square counter end, same height and sage panel joinery as row 1, simple worktop and open staff side.
Row 3: single 1 by 1 counter-height hinged wooden hatch/gate: two sturdy posts, brass/iron hinges, closed slatted sage gate, narrow lift-up honey timber top. Draw the gate closed, same counter height, front/back hardware seen correctly. A gate, not a solid counter.
